name: @local/dsh-delete-session
description: Adds a Delete session row to every sidebar session menu, after the built-in Archive action. The confirmation dialog names the session and says the deletion cannot be undone; confirming it permanently removes the session's log directory, its subagent sessions, the projection cache and the workspace references, and the sidebar row disappears immediately. A session with work in flight is refused at first, and the dialog then offers Stop work and delete; a session that was only opened and is idle deletes without restarting DSH. Forked sessions and attachments are untouched, and a deletion cannot be undone. Turning the plugin off removes the row; sessions already deleted do not come back.

meta.title: 删除会话
meta.description: 给侧栏每个会话行的「…」菜单加一行「删除会话」，排在「归档会话」之后。确认框会写明会话名与「此操作不可撤销」，确认后永久删除该会话的日志目录、它的子代理会话、投影缓存与工作区引用，侧栏那一行立即消失。有任务在跑时先拒绝，并多给一个「停止任务并删除」；只是被打开过、当前空闲的会话可以直接删，不必重启 DSH。分叉出来的会话与附件不受影响，删除后无法恢复；停用插件后这一行菜单消失，已经删掉的会话也不会回来。
